import requests

def get_pubchem_compound(name):
    url = f"https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/{name}/property/MolecularWeight,MolecularFormula,IUPACName,CanonicalSMILES/JSON"
    r = requests.get(url)
    if r.status_code == 200:
        return r.json()
    else:
        return f"Error {r.status_code}: {r.text}"
